project_metadata.name: Automatizacion_Pedidos_Devoluciones
project_metadata.objective: Implementar una plataforma digital integrada basada en Power Platform que automatice y optimice los procesos de toma y aprobacion de pedidos, calculo de comisiones y recuperos, y gestion de devoluciones.
project_metadata.target_audience: Vendedores, Administradores Comerciales, Finanzas y Distribuidores de BONAPHARM

data_models.description: Registro principal de solicitudes de venta
Lineas de productos dentro de un pedido
Registro de solicitudes de devolucion de productos
Calculo de comisiones y recuperos por distribuidor

api_contracts.description: Retrieve active products from Dataverse catalog
Fetch inventory and invoice data from SAP API

user_stories: As a Vendedor, I want to register a new order so that it can be processed by the commercial team.
As a Vendedor, I want to add products and bonuses to my order so that the final price is calculated automatically.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in as Vendedor, When I fill the order form and add products, Then the system calculates the total based on the distributor minimums and saves the order with 'Enviado' status.
Given an order in progress, When I add a product marked as 'Bonificacion', Then the system sets its price to 0 and does not add it to the final total.

user_stories: As a Comercial, I want to review and approve or reject orders so that only valid orders are sent to distributors.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order in 'Enviado' status, When I review the quantities and prices and click Approve, Then the order status changes to 'Aprobado' and an email notification is sent to the distributor.

user_stories: As a Comercial, I want to register a return request so that the distributor can process the returned items.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing invoiced order, When I select products to return, input the quantity, and provide a reason, Then the system creates a return record, calculates the 'Valorizado', and notifies the administrator.

user_stories: As a Finanzas user, I want the system to calculate commissions automatically so that I can review them at the end of the month.
acceptance_criteria: Given approved orders for Dimexa, When the monthly process runs, Then the system calculates a 10% commission and generates an Excel report.
Given approved orders for Quimica, When the monthly process runs, Then the system calculates a 13% commission based on the price difference.

performance: El sistema debe manejar un promedio de 500 solicitudes mensuales.
El sistema debe soportar una tasa de crecimiento del 20% mensual durante los proximos 24 meses.
security: Cifrado automatico con AES-256 y TLS 1.2+.
Autenticacion Segura con Azure AD (Entra ID), OAuth2.0 y Open ID.
Soporte de MFA para usuarios del EntraID.
Prevencion contra Inyeccion SQL y XSS.
Configuracion mediante roles y permisos RBAC.
scalability: Escalable horizontal y verticalmente en volumen de transacciones y usuarios concurrentes.
Interfaz responsive en resolucion maxima HD (desktop, tablets, smartphones).
availability: Tiempo de inactividad minimo del 99.99% planificado.
Respaldo incremental de base de datos en Azure durante el dia y full backup todos los dias.
El sistema no soportara capacidades offline.
